title: Combat art set
description: One named combat-art meta-tile set. Cells name curated tiles from tools/level_editor/public/tiles/combat/ (see tools/compose_battle_sprites.py LAYOUT); null is the all-white blank cell. frame1 omitted repeats frame0 (single-frame set).

palette.description: BG-stamp ramp name from assets/palette.txt (must hold a base slot). OAM sets encode with obj_palette instead.

oam.description: Render this set as OAM sprites instead of the BG stamp (small enemies only; boss stays BG). Requires obj_palette.

obj_palette.description: OBJ ramp name (SLOTS/OBJ) for OAM sets; transparent slot 0.

obj_alt_palette.description: Optional second OBJ ramp for OAM sets with one off-ramp cell (spider eye): programmed into BATTLE_OBJ_SCRATCH2 at battle entry. Requires obj_alt_cells.

obj_alt_cells.description: Frame0-relative cell indices (row-major) drawn with obj_alt_palette. Mask is uint8, so width*height must be <= 8.

glow.description: Eye-glow overlay for BG-stamped sets: these frame0-relative cells (row-major) are redrawn as OAM sprites over the stamp, flipping between two OBJ palettes on the battle clock. Both ramps must match the set palette at indices 0/2/3 and differ only at index 1 (the blink pixel), so only that shade remaps. Every cell index must be < 6 (one OAM stride per enemy slot).
